descriptions.preferred: 红皮是一款经典的观枝品种， 冬季枝条的色彩极为动人 。 就像永不过时的 "珊瑚阁（Sango kaku）"一样，当年生枝条在冬季是明亮的红色，这种色彩可以持续到第二年。 "红皮"叶片萌发的时间比"珊瑚阁"晚两周，长势也要慢些。 红皮 叶片大小中等， 5 到 7裂 ， 裂叶阔卵形，叶缘为寻常的重锯齿。 叶柄短而纤细，呈粉色至红色。 春天叶片呈 嫩 绿色，叶缘带有淡红色。 夏季是亮绿色， 秋季叶片 呈现迷人的金黄色到橙色， 与其红色的枝条形成强烈的对比。 因此无论是冬季观杆，还是用于景观的核心区域， "红皮"都非常迷人。 它的品种名意为"红色的树皮" 。 它可以长成直立的灌木或小乔木， 成年 株高 约为 4到 5米 。

rhs.description: A deciduous small tree about 3-4m in height, similar to the popular 'Sango Kaku' with strong coral-red winter stems and bearing 5-lobed leaves, opening pinkish-yellow, becoming green is summer then yellow in autumn; small, reddish spring flowers and winged fruits in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Wildlife Gardens
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。
attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、野生动物友好型花园

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶小乔木，高约 3-4 米，与流行品种 'Sango Kaku' 相似，冬季枝条呈鲜明的珊瑚红色。 叶片 5 裂，初展时粉黄色，夏季转绿，秋季变黄；春季开小型带红色调的花，秋季结翅果。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Beni kawa' Coral Bark Japanese Maple
products.description_text: An upright vase shaped form of coral bark maple. The bark is usually more red in winter compared to the salmon color of it's more famous cousin 'Sango kaku'. 'Beni kawa' also tends to be slightly wider and shorter. You will sometimes see 'Beni kawa' spelled as 'Beni gawa', this is due to a translation error when it was first brought to the U.S. and some growers have never corrected the mistake. Fall color ranges from yellow to orange and usually is an attractive combination of both. The foliage would like a little break from the summer sun in hotter climates, but the more winter sun the tree gets the more intense the bark color will be. 10 Year size: Height: 12-14 Feet Width: 8-10 Feet Spring Color: Green Summer Color: Green Fall Color: Orange Sun Tolerance: Full Planting: Elevated, Well Drained Soil
